title: Architecture and interaction visual vocabulary
summary: Illustrative, not an implementation diagram. Nine node kinds and six relationship kinds together: silhouette and color identify nodes; line pattern, arrowhead and color distinguish relationships. Node and edge colors are independent vocabularies. States describe conditions, not live execution status.

nodes.label: Human
nodes.description: Participant who initiates a request, not a state or a container.

nodes.label: Dirac harness
nodes.description: Software participant. Actor geometry does not imply a human subtype.

nodes.label: Feedback pending
nodes.description: Saved comments have not been submitted to the conversation.

nodes.label: Feedback submitted
nodes.description: Feedback is durably accepted, not necessarily consumed or addressed.

edges.label: feedback comments
edges.description: Communication between participants does not assert synchronous invocation or consumption.

edges.label: Send Feedback [owner available]
edges.description: Human initiates submission; the harness persists feedback before acknowledging acceptance.
